data_role: Same frozen 48h as prior comparison; entirely observed development data
previous_search_count: Earlier 4 exit candidates, QV2 7 combinations, plus the trade-level QV3 examples already inspected; full older research count unknown

new_components.ENTRY_WEAK: last 3 completed 1m highs and closes strictly decrease; last 2 bearish
new_components.EXIT_ONE: since entry a fully post-entry completed close exceeded entry by 0.2%; latest completed bar bearish
new_components.EXIT_TWO: same favorable-close prerequisite; latest 2 completed bars bearish and descending closes

actual_slippage: Already embedded in fills, never deduct again
execution_model: Conditional on the same historical entries; no replacement signals, no full cash/slot replay; sampled 1m quotes and stop levels; not an account backtest

classification.SUPERIOR: Every preserved and additional gate passes using independently validated account replay
classification.INFERIOR: Robustness or performance gate worsens versus current baseline; research-only result if fidelity fails
classification.DEFER: Insufficient sample, missing costs, missing account replay, fidelity failure or unstable result

stop_rule: No live promotion on failed fidelity or evidence gates. Preserve all failures. Diagnostic calculations may expose failure patterns but cannot establish account superiority.
deployment: No live orders, controls, circuit changes or strategy deployment by this research run
existing_positions: No candidate application; pure offline module only
notes: Main comparison simulates baseline and candidates on same 1m timeline; secondary actual-bid overlay keeps real exit if no earlier candidate trigger, NOT a baseline replay.
